body: GP tests gp-1116 and gp-1117 found cross-exam content reuse that may allow Kai to pattern-match answers between tests. Details: 27 hint strings appear verbatim in 2+ exams (RP1-RP2 and RP6-RP7 share identical hints for same question slots). 53 feedback_correct strings are identical across exams. Kai could memorize the congratulatory message instead of learning the math. Recommendation: GR should review whether these shared strings are acceptable (early exams = foundational scaffolding) or should be diversified. No hard failures -- advisory only. See tests for full list.
subject: 27 hints + 53 feedback_correct strings duplicated across exams
